Diagnose, test, and repair electronic fuel injection systems and engine management components

Install, maintain, and repair electronic monitoring and control devices 
Interpret technical diagrams, wiring schematics, and manufacturer specifications 
Conduct testing and ensure all repairs meet quality and safety standards 
Maintain accurate service records and documentation 
Work collaboratively with technicians and workshop staff to ensure efficient service delivery 

The Person  
Qualified Electronic Instrument Trades Worker or equivalent automotive electrical qualification

result.description:
We are looking for motivated and experienced Kitchenhands to join our team at the vibrant Divers Tavern. 

Number of positions: 2
Location: Broome, Western Australia
Type: Full-time
Salary: $71,550 to $75,000 commensurate with skills, experience and responsibilities.

Duties:
- Cut, chop, mix and pack food ingredients.
- Assist with preparation of meals and snack foods.
- Clean kitchen surfaces and wash dishes/utensils/pans.
- Clean food display and storage fridges.
- Assist with heating and toasting meals. 
- Prepare food trays for serving.
- Adhere to WHS and hygiene protocols.
- Other general kitchen duties as required.

Essential:
- Completion of secondary education or higher.
- At least one year of full-time experience as a Kitchenhand.
- A good level of verbal communication.
- Able to work efficiently in a fast-paced.
- Able to work in a rotating roster, including evenings and weekends. 
- Australian citizenship or Permanent Residence.

Desirable:
- Experience working in busy, fast-paced establishments.
Other information:
- Police check may be required. 
- Pre-start medical testing may be required. 
- Drug and alcohol testing may be required, with zero tolerance to intoxication at the workplace.

How to apply:
Do not apply through this website. Send an email to applications.arafutura @gmail.com (no space) with the subject line ‘Divers Tavern Kitchenhand application’. You must include a resume and contact details for at least 2 recent professional referees. Only candidates seeking full-time employment should apply. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Applications close 14/08/25.

result.description:
Supagas is a leading supplier of LPG, industrial, medical, specialty and helium gases in Australia. They are a fast-growing nation-wide company and are rapidly building a reputation for growth and success based on an exceptional ‘YES WE CAN’ customer service offering and quality product in the highly competitive market.

They are seeking experienced Bulk Delivery Drivers to join their team. Location: Australia-wide.

The Role:
The primary purpose of this role is to promote and Foster the “Yes We Can” attitude with both internal and external customers and representing Supagas in a positive and professional manner, to comply with all safety and regulatory requirements regarding the Transport of Dangerous Goods, securing a load, and other road rules relevant to the vehicle being driven.

Task List:
Follow correct procedures and be an example to fellow workers
Check daily that vehicle is roadworthy, equipped with all necessary safety equipment and is clean.
Make sure the truck is serviced as per the manufacturer’s requirements and Supagas procedures.
Make sure that the tanker is filled with sufficient amounts of LPG to cover all daily deliveries
Make sure all daily documentation, including but not limited to all delivery docket and manifests, is completed fully and correctly, all counts completed and checked, and all paperwork, cheques and cash handed in every day.
Deliver all orders and milk runs on the allocated daily run
Communicate all issues and non-deliveries immediately to the Logistics team
Respect all customer’s property and requirements.
Assist the company to educate our customers and make sure all customers handle and store gas appropriately and safely.
Carry out any housekeeping to maintain a safe workplace on and off the road.
Immediately report any factors which create an unsafe site for bulk deliveries to the Logistics Manager for follow up and also prior to delivery if known.
Assist the company to make sure maximum utilisation of company assets and protection of those assets.
Before every fill check test dates of cylinders and report out of date cylinders to the Logistics team.
Check Compliance Plates for all fixed Installations prior to refill and report non-compliant sites to the Logistics team.
Support the sales team and build the area by referring potential customers.
Make sure personal compliance with regulations regarding Dangerous Goods Licences.
Make sure you have the correct and adequate drivers licence for bulk delivery transportation.
Immediate reporting of any vehicle or property damage (no matter how small or large) to Logistics Manager.
Other general duties as assigned and required.
Promoting the benefits of Supagas & Supagas products
Work in a team environment and work together to maximise the productivity of the team.
Maintain safety, tidiness and housekeeping throughout entire office.
Report any hazards or problems immediately to your Supervisor at all times.

If you wish to apply for this position please submit updated resume
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
result.title: Bulk Delivery Driver

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Better and fairer care. Always.

We are St Vincent's Health Australia, Australia's largest not-for-profit provider of health and aged care services. 

Founded by The Sisters of Charity in 1857, our +30,000 healthcare superheroes operate public and private hospitals, residential aged care, community and virtual care, and outreach programs. 

About the role

Be part of a busy and collaborative team providing first and second-level technical support for computer systems, software, and hardware issues, both remotely and face-to-face.

Troubleshoot, monitor, and restore personal computers and devices connected to the network

Deliver high-quality client service, managing issues with integrity, compassion, and timely resolution

Work from various sites across our Hospital and Aged Care network to resolve technical incidents

Maintains telecommunications systems by installing, operating, and maintaining voice and data communications services.

Participate in the after-hours on-call roster

About you

Current Australian driver's license and reliable vehicle able to transport I.T. hardware and available after hours is MUST (cannot be a motorbike or scooter)

Certificate IV in Information Technology Support (or equivalent IT qualification)

Minimum 3+ years' experience in field engineering, desktop support or IT technical roles

Strong knowledge and skills in PC hardware and associated devices

Good understanding and associated skills in networking.

Must be able to commit to fulltime hours, including after-hours on-call requirements as detailed above

Why work at St Vincent's?

Join us on our mission to provide care to all, including the most at-risk people in our community

Discounted access to many gyms for you and your family with Fitness Passport

Access to discounted private health insurance with Medibank

Access to a salary sacrifice program (smart salary). Make a proportion of your salary tax-free!

Committed to financial support for educational development, scholarship programs, paid study leave

Sponsorship - work rights for Australia

Please note, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. For this role you must be an Australian or New Zealand citizen or have an Australia visa that grants you the work rights necessary for the role.

Pre-employment checks

Your employment is conditional upon the completion of all role-required pre-employment checks, including relevant immunisations.

Equal opportunity

We celebrate diversity & inclusion and are committed to equal employment opportunity for everyone.

How to apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting how your interest, skills, and experience align with the role.

Respectfully, this role is not open to recruitment agencies.

result.description:
Our valued client, NEWCO FARMS is seeking a dedicated and experienced Animal Husbandry Technician to join their dynamic team. The ideal candidate will provide daily care, including feeding and cleaning, and monitoring the health and behavior of animals in the farm. Key responsibilities involve administering medications, assisting with procedures, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring the animals' living environments are clean and safe, all while adhering to strict specific protocols of Newco Farms.

Work location: Tamworth NSW

Duties include but will not be limited to:
Monitors and maintains the health and welfare of livestock
Assists with breeding and raising livestock
Monitors livestock to evaluate the effectiveness of feed formulae, and assists with the management of livestock nutrition and feeding programs
Provide food, water, and a clean-living environment for animals, which includes cleaning cages and enclosures
Observe animals for any signs of illness or distress, monitor their behavior, and report concerns to veterinary or research staff
Assists in controlled breeding experiments to develop improved livestock strains
Administer prescribed medications and treatments, and assist veterinarians with medical procedures in strict compliance to Newco Farm’s guidelines including completion of all relevant reports and documentation. Such paperwork to be completed within the required timeframes
Artificially inseminates livestock for breeding purposes, conducts pregnancy tests, manages lactation, and cares for young animals
Collects and collates data for research purposes
Maintain detailed and accurate records of animal care, health, treatments, and procedures performed
Ensure animal housing areas and equipment are clean, sterile, and in good working order
Undertake or reorganise any work procedure as directed by the General Manager and Veterinary Services Manager or as deemed necessary in the absence of a member of staff
Safely handle and restrain animals for procedures, transportation, or other tasks
Ensure strict compliance with the principles of quarantine and biosecurity by all Newco Farm's farming operations
Report workplace hazards identified during the course of work to appropriate person according to standard operating procedures
Assist in the development and maintenance of Safe Work Practises. Support and implement the Company's Accident Prevention Program - support employees/work groups to ensure area is incident/accident free

Skills and knowledge
Proficiency in techniques for safely handling and restraining animals is essential
Ability to interpret animal behavior and a strong understanding of animal welfare principles are crucial
Knowledge of animal health, common diseases, and proper sanitation and hygiene practices is necessary
Organisational skills and familiarity with relevant software for record-keeping are important for maintaining accurate data
Strong communication skills are vital for working effectively with colleagues and supervisors
Technical skills on administering medication, performing basic lab techniques, or using specific farm equipment
Familiarity with regulations governing animal care is required

If you are ready to contribute to a positive and collaborative work environment, and feels this job could be the perfect opportunity for you, please apply now.
Salary: $100,000 per annum
